metadata.question: In the summer of 2021, did at least 6 million hectares of forests burn in Sakha?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Sakha Republic, Russia (very large region in eastern Siberia) - Time: Summer 2021 (June-August 2021) - Collection: MODIS burned area products (MCD64A1 or FireCCI51) or active fire products - Best approach: Use MODIS Burned Area Monthly (MCD64A1) which provides burned area detection 2. Masking strategy: - Need to identify burned pixels in forest areas - Use burned area band to detect fires - May need forest mask to identify forest-specific burns - Calculate total burned forest area in hectares 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero (B): Collection exists, processing succeeds, but burned area < 6 million ha - A: Burned area >= 6 million ha - C1: No images found for the region/time - C2: No valid pixels after processing - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN or invalid result 4. Approach: - Define Sakha Republic geometry - Get MODIS burned area data for summer 2021 - Calculate total burned area in forest regions - Convert to hectares and compare to 6 million threshold ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions // Sakha Republic (Yakutia), Russia - approximate bounds const sakha = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[105, 55], [105, 73], [165, 73], [165, 55], [105, 55]] ]); const summerStart = '2021-06-01'; const summerEnd = '2021-08-31'; console.log('Analyzing burned forest area in Sakha Republic, summer 2021...'); // 2. Data Acquisition & Check // Use MODIS Burned Area Monthly product const burnedCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MCD64A1') .filterDate(summerStart, summerEnd) .filterBounds(sakha); const colSize = burnedCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Burned area images found: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { console.log('No burned area data for summer 2021.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Get forest cover data for masking const forestCover = ee.Image('UMD/hansen/global_forest_change_2021_v1_9') .select('treecover2000'); // Forest mask: areas with >30% tree cover in 2000 const forestMask = forestCover.gt(30); // 3. Processing - Calculate burned area // BurnDate band: day of year of burn detection (values 1-366, 0=unburned) const burnedArea = burnedCol.select('BurnDate') .max() // Get any burn during the period .gt(0) // Convert to binary: 1=burned, 0=not burned .updateMask(forestMask) // Apply forest mask .clip(sakha); // Check for valid pixels const pixelCount = burnedArea.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: sakha, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('BurnDate').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid burned forest pixels: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log('No valid burned forest pixels detected.'); console.log('B'); return; } // 4. Calculation - Sum burned area // Each MODIS pixel is 500m x 500m = 250,000 m² = 0.025 hectares const pixelArea = ee.Image.pixelArea().divide(10000); // Convert m² to hectares const totalBurnedHa = burnedArea.multiply(pixelArea).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: sakha, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('BurnDate').getInfo(); console.log(`Total burned forest area: ${(totalBurnedHa / 1000000).toFixed(2)} million hectares`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (totalBurnedHa === null || totalBurnedHa === undefined || isNaN(totalBurnedHa)) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid result.'); console.log('C3'); return; } const threshold = 6000000; // 6 million hectares if (totalBurnedHa >= threshold) { console.log(`Burned area (${(totalBurnedHa / 1000000).toFixed(2)}M ha) >= 6M ha threshold`); console.log('A'); } else { console.log(`Burned area (${(totalBurnedHa / 1000000).toFixed(2)}M ha) < 6M ha threshold`); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
